data.body: **[P2] Guard plugin-controlled cause traversal.** This loop repeatedly calls `getCause()` without cycle detection or an exception boundary. A custom `CompletionException`/`ExecutionException` with a cyclic or throwing cause accessor can hang scope opening or abort cleanup, replace the durable outcome, and leave earlier scopes unclosed. Use an identity-tracked walk that reads each cause once under a guard, treating unreadable/cyclic chains as ordinary failures while still propagating JVM-fatal causes; add open and close regressions.
